justification: Historical High: extract-zip@2.0.1 was present via @electron/packager 18.x (Forge 7.11.2) and @puppeteer/browsers 2.x. No patched extract-zip release exists. ADR 0008 allowed a time-boxed MERGE_ONLY exception while promotion stayed blocked. Controller-authorized Forge 8.0.0-alpha.10 (prerelease; upstream not ready for general consumption) is the first declared Forge graph whose Packager ^20.0.1 depends on @electron-internal/extract-zip instead of unscoped extract-zip. tests/desktop-e2e independently overrides @puppeteer/browsers to 3.2.3 (WDIO 9.x retained). There is no undeclared @electron/packager override. Unscoped extract-zip is ABSENT from both npm lockfiles. This manifest must not ignore CVE-2026-56876 / GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv. Independent technical QA verdict SF001_FORGE8_CANDIDATE_QA_PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS. Human Independent Reviewer / Project Owner APPROVED the reviewed candidate (ccc95cddca6691781485c47ba4b5d21d872bca09 / tree 6535523e5e7fdd88625f7bb78641a2d83c5daffd) including the six reported nonblocking QA findings. This approval is scoped to SF-001 / P02-AUDIT-006 only. It does not close G-08-04 or P02-AUDIT-007. It does not claim the repository has zero High findings. It does not authorize promotion.
